It is a state at one observation: it says nothing of whether a occupies r, of the path a followed before, or of why a moves so. Not denoted: a road user at rest or moving at or below speed_tol; one travelling counter-clockwise about the point; one moving towards or away from the point within the angle sin_tol allows; one at the point itself. lines: {"concept_id":"drv.motion.parked","kind":"formula","contract":"Road user a is parked: \"the standing of a vehicle, whether occupied or not\", observed as a at rest at every observation of the window behind the observation, of length min_duration: at each of them a's speed (kin.speed, read through drv.motion.complete_halt) is at or below speed_tol. A halt shorter than min_duration, which may be the temporary halt the definition leaves out, is not denoted. It denotes a state at one observation: it says nothing of whether a rider is on a, of where a stands, or of why it stands. Not denoted: a road user whose speed was above speed_tol at some observation of that window. Where the window reaches before the start of the recording or a speed in it is unobserved, it is unknown.","definition":"DEF-NRS-484A-155","args":[{"name":"a","sort":"track"}],"params":[{"name":"speed_tol","unit":"m/s","meaning":"the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution"},{"name":"min_duration","unit":"s","meaning":"the length of the window behind over which the road user must have been at rest: the longest halt that still counts as a temporary one"}],"elements":[{"span":"a at rest at every observation of the window behind the observation, of length min_duration","atoms":[],"concepts":["drv.motion.complete_halt"],"justification":"drv.motion.complete_halt: 'The road user is at rest at the observation ... observed as its speed (kin.speed) at or below a tolerance the caller sets'; holding it at every observation of a window behind (holdsFor over time) is the standing the definition names, 'whether occupied or not', so no occupancy is read."}],"residues":[{"span":"otherwise than temporarily for the purpose of and while actually engaged in loading or unloading of merchandise or passengers","why":"a purpose is not observable; the definition's exclusion of a temporary halt is read only by the halt's duration (min_duration): a halt held longer than min_duration while loading is denoted, a halt shorter than it for any purpose is not"}],"scenarios":[{"name":"holds","expected":"compliant","narrative":"A bicycle stands at rest beside the curb at every observation of the window behind, with no rider on it."},{"name":"fails","expected":"violated","narrative":"A bicycle halts briefly and moves off again within the window behind: its speed is above the tolerance at some observation of the window."},{"name":"blind","expected":"unknown","narrative":"The source supplies no speed for the bicycle during the window.","masked":["kin.speed"]}],"used_by":["LVMC_11_40_170"],"supersedes":null}

{"concept_id":"drv.motion.circulating_clockwise_about","kind":"formula","contract":"Road user a travels clockwise about the reference point of region r, as seen from above: the point lies to the right of a's direction of travel and a's velocity turns about it clockwise. It is observed with a's position (kin.position), a's velocity (kin.velocity), a's speed (kin.speed) and r's reference point (st.region_geometry), in the world frame, in which a turn to the left is counter-clockwise (the frame of kin.yaw_rate): with d the vector from r's reference point to a's position, the cross product of d with a's velocity is negative, and its square exceeds sin_tol squared times the squared length of d times the square of a's speed, so that the share of a's motion that turns about the point is above sin_tol; and a's speed is above speed_tol. It is a state at one observation: it says nothing of whether a occupies r, of the path a followed before, or of why a moves so. Not denoted: a road user at rest or moving at or below speed_tol; one travelling counter-clockwise about the point; one moving towards or away from the point within the angle sin_tol allows; one at the point itself. Where r's reference point, a's position or a's velocity is unobserved, it is unknown.","definition":null,"args":[{"name":"a","sort":"track"},{"name":"r","sort":"region"}],"params":[{"name":"speed_tol","unit":"m/s","meaning":"the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement"},{"name":"sin_tol","unit":"ratio","meaning":"the share of the speed, across the line to the reference point, at or below which motion counts as towards or away from the point rather than around it"}],"elements":[{"span":"a's position (kin.position)","atoms":["kin.position"],"concepts":[],"justification":"kin.position: 'position of the body's reference point', world frame; the vector from r's reference point to it is d."},{"span":"a's velocity (kin.velocity)","atoms":["kin.velocity"],"concepts":[],"justification":"kin.velocity: 'velocity vector', world frame; its cross product with d gives the sense of travel about the point."},{"span":"a's speed (kin.speed)","atoms":["kin.speed"],"concepts":[],"justification":"kin.speed: 'magnitude of velocity'; it bounds the share of the motion turning about the point and excludes a road user at rest."},{"span":"r's reference point (st.region_geometry)","atoms":["st.region_geometry"],"concepts":[],"justification":"st.region_geometry: 'the reference point and the boundary polygon of a structure region in the world frame'; the reference point is the point travel is judged about. Not a stand-in for occupancy: the concept reads no footprint."}],"residues":[],"scenarios":[{"name":"holds","expected":"compliant","narrative":"A car moves around the reference point of the region keeping the point on its right, its velocity mostly across the line to the point."},{"name":"fails","expected":"violated","narrative":"A car moves around the reference point keeping the point on its left (counter-clockwise)."},{"name":"blind","expected":"unknown","narrative":"The region is mapped without its reference point and boundary.","masked":["st.region_geometry"]}],"used_by":["LVMC_11_43_010_A"],"supersedes":null}

lines: {"concept_id":"drv.motion.parked","kind":"formula","contract":"Road user a is parked: \"the standing of a vehicle, whether occupied or not\", observed as a at rest at every observation of the window behind the observation, of length min_duration: at each of them a's speed (kin.speed, read through drv.motion.complete_halt) is at or below speed_tol. It denotes a state at one observation: it says nothing of whether a rider is on a, of where a stands, or of why it stands. Not denoted: a road user whose speed was above speed_tol at some observation of that window. {"concept_id":"drv.motion.circulating_clockwise_about","kind":"formula","contract":"Road user a travels clockwise about the reference point of region r, as seen from above: the point lies to the right of a's direction of travel and a's velocity turns about it clockwise. It is a state at one observation: it says nothing of whether a occupies r, of the path a followed before, or of why a moves so. Not denoted: a road user at rest or moving at or below speed_tol; one travelling counter-clockwise about the point; one moving towards or away from the point within the angle sin_tol allows; one at the point itself. lines: {"concept_id":"drv.motion.parked","kind":"formula","contract":"Road user a is parked: \"the standing of a vehicle, whether occupied or not\", observed as a at rest at every observation of the window behind the observation, of length min_duration: at each of them a's speed (kin.speed, read through drv.motion.complete_halt) is at or below speed_tol. lines: {"concept_id":"drv.motion.parked","kind":"formula","contract":"Road user a is parked: \"the standing of a vehicle, whether occupied or not\", observed as a at rest at every observation of the window behind the observation, of length min_duration: at each of them a's speed (kin.speed, read through drv.motion.complete_halt) is at or below speed_tol. A halt shorter than min_duration, which may be the temporary halt the definition leaves out, is not denoted. It denotes a state at one observation: it says nothing of whether a rider is on a, of where a stands, or of why it stands. Not denoted: a road user whose speed was above speed_tol at some observation of that window. Where the window reaches before the start of the recording or a speed in it is unobserved, it is unknown.","definition":"DEF-NRS-484A-155","args":[{"name":"a","sort":"track"}],"params":[{"name":"speed_tol","unit":"m/s","meaning":"the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution"},{"name":"min_duration","unit":"s","meaning":"the length of the window behind over which the road user must have been at rest: the longest halt that still counts as a temporary one"}],"elements":[{"span":"a at rest at every observation of the window behind the observation, of length min_duration","atoms":[],"concepts":["drv.motion.complete_halt"],"justification":"drv.motion.complete_halt: 'The road user is at rest at the observation ... observed as its speed (kin.speed) at or below a tolerance the caller sets'; holding it at every observation of a window behind (holdsFor over time) is the standing the definition names, 'whether occupied or not', so no occupancy is read."}],"residues":[{"span":"otherwise than temporarily for the purpose of and while actually engaged in loading or unloading of merchandise or passengers","why":"a purpose is not observable; the definition's exclusion of a temporary halt is read only by the halt's duration (min_duration): a halt held longer than min_duration while loading is denoted, a halt shorter than it for any purpose is not"}],"scenarios":[{"name":"holds","expected":"compliant","narrative":"A bicycle stands at rest beside the curb at every observation of the window behind, with no rider on it."},{"name":"fails","expected":"violated","narrative":"A bicycle halts briefly and moves off again within the window behind: its speed is above the tolerance at some observation of the window."},{"name":"blind","expected":"unknown","narrative":"The source supplies no speed for the bicycle during the window.","masked":["kin.speed"]}],"used_by":["LVMC_11_40_170"],"supersedes":null}

{"concept_id":"drv.motion.circulating_clockwise_about","kind":"formula","contract":"Road user a travels clockwise about the reference point of region r, as seen from above: the point lies to the right of a's direction of travel and a's velocity turns about it clockwise. It is observed with a's position (kin.position), a's velocity (kin.velocity), a's speed (kin.speed) and r's reference point (st.region_geometry), in the world frame, in which a turn to the left is counter-clockwise (the frame of kin.yaw_rate): with d the vector from r's reference point to a's position, the cross product of d with a's velocity is negative, and its square exceeds sin_tol squared times the squared length of d times the square of a's speed, so that the share of a's motion that turns about the point is above sin_tol; and a's speed is above speed_tol. It is a state at one observation: it says nothing of whether a occupies r, of the path a followed before, or of why a moves so. Not denoted: a road user at rest or moving at or below speed_tol; one travelling counter-clockwise about the point; one moving towards or away from the point within the angle sin_tol allows; one at the point itself. Not a stand-in for occupancy: the concept reads no footprint."}],"residues":[],"scenarios":[{"name":"holds","expected":"compliant","narrative":"A car moves around the reference point of the region keeping the point on its right, its velocity mostly across the line to the point."},{"name":"fails","expected":"violated","narrative":"A car moves around the reference point keeping the point on its left (counter-clockwise)."},{"name":"blind","expected":"unknown","narrative":"The region is mapped without its reference point and boundary.","masked":["st.region_geometry"]}],"used_by":["LVMC_11_43_010_A"],"supersedes":null}

Read at the entry onto the sidewalk: emerging = at the observation before the entry the subject occupies an alley or a driveway/alley entrance, or occupies no highway region; entering into = at the entry the subject occupies an alley or a driveway/alley entrance (the sidewalk area extending across it), or from the entry it occupies the sidewalk until it occupies no highway region (the movement into a building read by the movement itself)."},{"span":"e4","atoms":[],"derived":["drv.motion.complete_halt"],"justification":"Same words as the mapping index (LVMC_11_20_060_o1): drv.motion.complete_halt, whose definition DEF-NRS-484A-255 applies to 'Stop, when required' ('complete cessation from movement'); the stop is required here, so DEF-NRS-484A-260 (stopping when prohibited) does not apply. 'such vehicle' refers back to the device the subject operates; it is not a new class condition (the vehicle definition DEF-NRS-484A-320 excludes devices moved by human power, electric bicycles and electric scooters, so reading it as a class would empty the duty). 'immediately prior to' places the halt in the stopping zone just short of the sidewalk, read with e5."},{"span":"e5","atoms":["rel.occupies","st.region_geometry","st.sidewalk"],"derived":[],"justification":"Same atoms as the mapping index's 'driving onto a sidewalk or onto the sidewalk area extending across any alleyway or driveway'. st.sidewalk: 'area for pedestrians between roadway and property line' (not a crosswalk: none is meant); rel.occupies marks the event, the footprint coming to overlap the sidewalk; st.region_geometry: 'the ground distance from a road user's body outline to it' bounds the stopping zone outside the sidewalk. input.content:
# Plan — batch 04 (LVMC 11.40.130 – 11.43.010)

Ten nodes over eight law lines, and two new concept records. Every node is `accept` by the
validator. Two nodes carry atom gaps: `LVMC_11_40_170` (two gaps) and `LVMC_11_40_180_B` (one gap).
The coder does not write those two nodes, and their laws stay blocked until the gaps are resolved.
`aggregates.jsonl` is empty. No law here defines its own members, and every aggregate claimed is
listed as admitted in the definitions table.

## Concepts proposed

- **`drv.motion.parked`** (definition `DEF-NRS-484A-155`). The road user is at rest at every
  observation of a window behind it, of length `min_duration`. The rest test reuses
  `drv.motion.complete_halt` with `speed_tol`.
  - The quoted words are "the standing of a vehicle, whether occupied or not", so no occupancy is
    read.
  - The definition's exclusion of a temporary loading halt is a purpose. A purpose cannot be
    observed, so it is a residue, read only through the halt's duration.
  - Reversal signal: a labelled recording where a long halt during loading is judged not parked.
    That would call for a gap on the purpose, not a different duration.
- **`drv.motion.circulating_clockwise_about`** (region formal `r`). The road user moves clockwise
  about `r`'s reference point.
  - The test is the sign of the cross product of the offset from that point with the velocity. A
    squared, sine-tolerance band excludes motion toward or away from the point (roundabout entry
    and exit).
  - Clockwise is read in the frame where a left turn is counter-clockwise, as `kin.yaw_rate`
    defines it.
  - The concept denotes clockwise, not counter-clockwise, so that radial motion is not a
    violation.
  - Reversal signal: a source whose roundabout reference point is not the centre of the island.

Reused, not re-proposed: `drv.motion.complete_halt` and `drv.interaction.overtake_pass`. Neither
record declares an `act`, so no node here declares `occasion`.

## Nodes

**`LVMC_11_40_130` — bicycle speed (surrogate).**
- The whole duty is the standard "reasonable and prudent under the conditions then existing". It is
  operationalized as a bicycle stopping-sight-distance bound: reaction distance plus braking
  distance must not exceed the visibility.
- The surface selects the deceleration: `Term.cond` picks ice/snow, else wet or precipitation, else
  dry. Darkness caps the distance seen at the reach of a bicycle headlamp. Each factor moves the
  bound by its degree, not through one fixed switch.
- `st.sight_distance` was dropped. It needs a region kind and an anchor, and the text names no
  place. The catch-all is therefore disclosed as read only through visibility, surface and
  darkness; bends, crests, traffic density and grade are not read.
- "operate" is an `agency` observable reading. The rule applies only while the bicycle moves.
- Reversal signal: an operator decision to judge speed against sight distance on the travel region
  occupied. That would add `st.travel_region` + `rel.occupies` and narrow where the rule applies.

**`LVMC_11_40_140_o1` — halt before crossing the sidewalk.**
- This is the rule-4c duty of an act before an event, mapped the same way as `LVMC_11_20_060_o1`:
  "shall stop such vehicle immediately prior to" → `drv.motion.complete_halt`, and the sidewalk
  words → `rel.occupies`, `st.region_geometry`, `st.sidewalk`.
- The event is the subject's footprint coming onto sidewalk `s`. The place is the zone outside `s`
  within `p.stop_point_tolerance` of it.
- The search runs back through the run of observations within that zone. It ends at the approach
  start (the subject farther than the tolerance from `s`) or at the subject's previous occupancy of
  `s`. If it reaches neither end, the verdict is unknown; a `history_boundary` scenario covers this.
- **Deviation from the mapping index:** the trigger "entering into or emerging from an alley,
  driveway or building" adds `st.highway` to the earlier atoms (`rel.occupies`, `st.alley`,
  `st.driveway_or_alley_entrance`).
  - Why: "building" means coming from, or going to, beyond the property line. That is observable as
    occupying no `st.highway` region at the observation before entry, or occupying `s` until no
    highway region is occupied (entering a building, read through the movement itself).
  - The earlier mapping drops "building", which would narrow the trigger.
- "such vehicle" does not add a class condition. It refers back to the device the subject operates.
  `DEF-NRS-484A-320` excludes human-powered devices, electric bicycles and electric scooters, so
  reading it as a class would leave the duty empty. The vehicle aggregate is deliberately not
  claimed.
- "stop" resolves to `DEF-NRS-484A-255` ("when required"), the definition `complete_halt` carries.
- Reversal signal: the selection role insisting that "such vehicle" be claimed as an aggregate.

**`LVMC_11_40_140_o2` — yield to pedestrians while crossing the sidewalk.**
- "yielding the right-of-way to any pedestrian" → `kin.speed`, `rel.contact` (as the index maps
  "yielding") plus the pedestrian aggregate.
- The standard "as may be necessary to avoid collision" is bounded by the conflict technique:
  closest approach within `p.conflict_horizon` and below `p.conflict_centre_clearance`, while the
  subject moves.
- The rule applies while the subject stays on the sidewalk it entered under the o1 trigger. The
  trigger conditions are restated in full, not composed: the o1 node is not yet coded, and
  composing it would test compliance, not the event.
- A scenario with no pedestrian shows that the duty binds the subject alone.

**`LVMC_11_40_170` — parking (two atom gaps).**
- "park" → the new `drv.motion.parked` (`p.parking_min_duration`), with a `purpose` observable
  reading. "upon a street" → `st.highway` + `rel.occupies`. The city-limits half of the street
  definition is the code's own territorial scope, as the justification records.
- The allowed places are `exception` spans:
  - roadway against the curb: `rel.contact` with `st.road_edge`;
  - on the sidewalk at the curb: `st.region_geometry` distance to `st.road_edge` within
    `p.parked_edge_reach`.
- The standard "least obstruction to" (pedestrian traffic → pedestrian aggregate) means the body is
  within the placement margin of its edge and no pedestrian is in contact with it. The comparative
  "least" is disclosed as a narrowing.
- **Gaps:**

- "before" is a rule-4c search back from the pass onset, the last observation at which the
  pedestrian was ahead with headings aligned (`atLast` over `p.overtake_window`). The search covers
  the run in which the pedestrian stayed ahead and ends at its start. The `history_boundary`
  scenario covers a run that begins before the recording.
- The sidewalk trigger is read at some moment of the pass, documented in `applicability`.
  `branch_1` and `branch_2` cover a pass partly on the sidewalk and one where the rider is on the
  sidewalk only before the pass.
- Reversal signal: the pass concept gaining an `act` declaration, which would require an
  `occasion` block.

**`LVMC_11_43_010_A` — counterclockwise travel in a roundabout.**
- The preamble's "within a roundabout" → `rel.occupies` + `st.roundabout`. "All vehicular travel"
  → vehicle aggregate, not at rest.
- The obligation is the negation of `drv.motion.circulating_clockwise_about` on the occupied
  roundabout `r`, with `p.roundabout_clockwise_sin_tol`.
- The reference point is read as the centre of the island (a narrowing). The circulatory-roadway
  definition `DEF-LVMC-11-02-040` ("travel counterclockwise around a central island") supports
  this.
- An electric scooter is not applicable, because the vehicle definition excludes it.

**`LVMC_11_43_010_B_o1` — yield to vehicles already in the roundabout.**
- The event is the footprint coming onto the roundabout. "Already in" means a vehicle occupying it
  at the observation before and at the entry.
- Same conflict bound as the other yield nodes, judged at the entry.

**`LVMC_11_43_010_B_o2` — enter only at a gap in traffic.**
- A second obligation verb ("and wait … before entering"). "wait" is read as entering only at a
  gap; no halt is required where a gap already exists (a narrowing).
- The gap is the gap-acceptance standard: no traffic-aggregate member in the roundabout (pedestrians
  on its crosswalks included) comes within the clearance before `p.roundabout_critical_gap`.
- Reversal signal: a label requiring a halt at every entry.

## Parameters

- Proposed again with the values and conventions catalogued this iteration:
  `p.halt_speed_tolerance`, `p.stop_point_tolerance`, `p.conflict_horizon`,
  `p.conflict_centre_clearance`, `p.overtake_window`, `p.overtake_same_direction_cos`.
- New: `p.bicycle_reaction_time`, `p.bicycle_decel_dry`, `p.bicycle_decel_wet`,
  `p.bicycle_decel_ice`, `p.bicycle_lamp_reach`, `p.parking_min_duration`, `p.parked_edge_reach`,
  `p.roundabout_clockwise_sin_tol`, `p.roundabout_critical_gap`.

## For the operator

- **Gaps filed:**
  - `st.bicycle_rack` and `st.building` (both `LVMC-11-40-170`).
  - `dev.governs_walkway` (`LVMC-11-40-180-B`). The same need will recur for any sign-posted
    sidewalk restriction.
- **Frame handedness:** `drv.motion.circulating_clockwise_about` relies on the world frame in which
  a left turn is counter-clockwise, as the ontology states for `kin.yaw_rate` and
  `prim.region_lateral_offset`. A CARLA adapter that passes raw left-handed coordinates would
  reverse the sense.
- **Roundabout reference point:** `LVMC_11_43_010_A` needs the `st.roundabout` region's reference
  point at the centre of the central island. The manifest should say whether it is.
- **Audio:** sources without audio declare `sig.horn` and `sig.siren` absent, so
  `LVMC_11_40_180_C_o2` is unknown on them by design.
- **Fog/visibility:** `LVMC_11_40_130` is unknown wherever `env.visibility` is not observed.

content.text:
I've planned all eight laws as ten nodes and added two new concepts. The validator accepts every node and concept. Three of the laws are blocked on gaps I filed: 11.40.170 has two gaps (its whole law is one node) and 11.40.180(B) has one. The coder won't write those two nodes until the gaps are resolved. The output is `blueprint.jsonl` and `PLAN.md`; `aggregates.jsonl` is empty because none of these laws defines its own aggregate.

**New concepts**
- `drv.motion.parked` (from the definition of "park"): the device has been at rest for a set duration. The definition's "temporarily for loading or unloading" is a purpose, which can't be observed, so it is read only through how long the device has stood.
- `drv.motion.circulating_clockwise_about`: a road user moving clockwise around a region's reference point. The roundabout node requires that this does not hold.

**Nodes**

| Node | What it checks | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `LVMC_11_40_130` | Bicycle speed against a stopping-distance bound set by visibility, road surface and darkness | Coded later; marked surrogate |
| `LVMC_11_40_140_o1` | Halt just before riding onto the sidewalk from an alley, driveway or building | Coded later |
| `LVMC_11_40_140_o2` | Yield to pedestrians while crossing that sidewalk | Coded later |
| `LVMC_11_40_170` | Where a bicycle may be parked on a street | **Blocked:** no atom for a bike rack (`st.bicycle_rack`) or a building wall (`st.building`) |
| `LVMC_11_40_180_A` | No riding on the Fremont Street sidewalks (new assumption `asm.fremont_street_main_to_seventh`) | Coded later |
| `LVMC_11_40_180_B` | Obey signs prohibiting riding | **Blocked:** no atom ties a sign to a sidewalk (`dev.governs_walkway`); the roadway case is planned |
| `LVMC_11_40_180_C_o1` | Yield to pedestrians when riding on a sidewalk | Coded later |
| `LVMC_11_40_180_C_o2` | Sound a horn, bell or whistle before passing a pedestrian | Coded later |
| `LVMC_11_43_010_A` | Travel counterclockwise in a roundabout | Coded later |
| `LVMC_11_43_010_B_o1` | Yield to vehicles already in the roundabout when entering | Coded later |
| `LVMC_11_43_010_B_o2` | Enter only at a gap in traffic, pedestrians on the crosswalks included | Coded later |

**Decisions you may want to revisit**
- **"such vehicle" in 11.40.140:** I treated it as referring back to the bicycle or scooter and did not claim the vehicle aggregate. That aggregate's definition excludes bicycles, e-bikes and e-scooters, so claiming it would make the law apply to no one.
- **"building" in 11.40.140:** I read it as coming from (or going to) beyond the edge of the public way. That adds one atom to the mapping the earlier batch used for the same words in 11.20.060; without it, "building" would be dropped.
- **Riding is read as moving:** in several nodes, a bicycle pushed by someone walking counts as ridden, because the source can't tell rider from machine.
- **Dropped sight distance in 11.40.130:** the law names no place to read it at, so the speed check ignores bends and crests.
- **A spoken warning doesn't count** as the audible signal in 180(C)(o2); only horn, bell or whistle do.

**Things the data source needs to get right**
- The roundabout check assumes the world frame treats a left turn as counterclockwise. If the CARLA adapter passes raw CARLA coordinates, which use the opposite handedness, clockwise and counterclockwise swap.
- The roundabout's reference point is assumed to sit at the centre of its central island.
- Sources without audio will report the audible-signal rule as unknown.
- 11.40.130 is unknown wherever visibility isn't observed.

One extra command (`python -m harness validate --help`) was blocked by permissions. It wasn't needed: the validator run itself completed.
